artifact.title: Billing Summary
artifact.description: A client-facing breakdown of labor, material, and approved change order costs compiled by billing staff and shared with the client before invoicing.

fields.description: Primary identifier for the billing summary record.
Reference to the project this billing summary belongs to.
Lifecycle state of the billing summary, either in draft or shared with the client.
Start date of the billing period covered by this summary.
End date of the billing period covered by this summary.
Total labor cost derived from time logs within the billing period.
Total material cost derived from material usage within the billing period.
Total cost from approved change orders included in this billing period.
Sum of labor, material, and approved change order costs for the billing period.
Timestamp when the billing summary was shared with the client.
Timestamp when the billing summary record was created.
Timestamp of the last update to the billing summary record.
